gallery.deleteMemoryBody: The file goes with it, for good. There is no undo behind this one.
gallery.emptyBody: Make an album: one picture a day, playable as a run.
gallery.emptyTrashBody: Every picture in here is deleted for good, files and all. There is no undo.

gallery.noMatch: No picture has a note like that
gallery.onlyHere: Only in this browser until it is sent

gallery.searchHint: Search the notes on these pictures
gallery.seedHint: A scheduled album is due like a habit, checked in by adding a picture, and feeds the same streak.
gallery.storageHint: What this browser holds of the gallery
gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.tooLarge: That file is {{size}}; a file may be {{max}}.
gallery.trashEmptyBody: Deleted pictures and albums wait here.
gallery.trashKeepsFiles: The files are still kept. Emptying the trash is what removes them.

gym.accessoriesHint: Back, Abs — a note, not a prescription
gym.albumOfferBody: An album for this program, so a year of sessions has something to show for itself. It hangs off this habit rather than becoming a second one.
gym.alreadyRunning: A session is already running — here it is.
gym.barOver: Lighter than the bar: the bar alone is {{over}} over.
gym.bestVolumeHint: Weight times reps, added up over one session.
gym.catalogueHint: Search by name, muscle or equipment — the question mid-session is usually what else hits this.
gym.deleteDayBody: The exercises and sets in it go too.
gym.deleteProgramBody: Its days and sets go with it. Sessions you already finished stay.
gym.discardAgainBody_one: The set you logged is gone for good, and the session with it.
gym.discardAgainBody_other: All {{count}} sets are gone for good, and the session with them.
gym.discardBody_one: The one set you logged goes with it.
gym.discardBody_other: The {{count}} sets you logged go with it.
gym.discardBody_zero: Nothing is logged yet, so nothing is lost.
gym.dropSetBody: The set goes from this session. What you have already ticked stays.
gym.estimatedHint: Worked out from the weight and the reps (Epley), not a single you actually pulled.
gym.finishEmptyBody: It is kept as a session you turned up for, which is worth something, but no set counts towards a record.
gym.finishIncompleteBody: {{left}} of {{total}} sets are not ticked. The session ends here and the gym habit is checked in as done for today.
gym.howOftenBody: Days a week, not which days — the gym is not always on the day you meant.
gym.mineBody: One the catalogue is missing. It is yours: it syncs, and it works like any other everywhere.
gym.mineRemoveBody: Sessions that logged it keep its name. Programs that use it keep the slot.
gym.moreExercises_one: 1 more — search to narrow it down
gym.moreExercises_other: {{count}} more — search to narrow it down
gym.needsTrainingMaxBody: Until then its percentage sets show a percentage rather than a weight.
gym.noDaysBody: Add a day. Duplicating it later is one click.
gym.noExerciseBody: Try a muscle or a piece of equipment instead of a name.
gym.noPercentSets: Nothing in this program is a percentage, so there is nothing to set.
gym.noProgramToStartBody: Write a program first — a session is a day of one, with the weights already filled in.
gym.noProgramsBody: Write the first day. No generator: a program is a list you fill in.
gym.noRecords: Nothing logged for this one yet
gym.noSessionsBody: Start one. The records are made of what you log.
gym.noTrainingMax: Not set — percentage sets cannot resolve
gym.openSetHint: As many as you can — the set that decides whether the weight goes up
gym.phoneOnly: A session is run on the phone: it is ticked one-handed, between sets.
gym.photoPrompt: When to ask for the picture

gym.pickDayBody: The day after the last one you finished leads; any other is one click further.
gym.pictureNowBody: One for the album, while you are still here.
gym.plantProgramBody: It becomes a habit like any other, and finishing a session checks it in.
gym.plateShortfall: Closest is {{total}} — {{short}} short. A bar loads in pairs, so it cannot make every number.
gym.recordEstimated: Best set yet — about {{load}} for one
gym.reorderHint: Drag, or use the arrow keys
gym.restToday: For this session only; the program stays as it is.
gym.runningSessionBody: {{done}} of {{total}} sets done. Finish or drop it before starting another.
gym.searchExercises: Search by name, muscle or kit
gym.seedBareHint: Checked in as a session with nothing logged
gym.seedQuestion: A gym seed is checked in by a session.
gym.seedStartHint: The program's day, sets and all
gym.sessionFinishedBody: It is in the history now.
gym.sessionNoteHint: Slept badly, belt on, gym was packed…
gym.setsSubtitle: What this asks of you, set by set.
gym.skipHint: Shoulder still sore, short on time…
gym.trainingMaxesHint: The number your percentages are percentages of. Yours to set and yours to bump — the app does not do your programming.

home.ctaBody: Install the Android app, or open Harvest right here and add it to your home screen.

field.body: Every seed has its own rhythm. The field shows only what is due today, and the day starts at 3 AM, so a late night still counts for the evening it belongs to.
field.p1: Habits daily, on set days, every few days, or a number of times a week
field.p2: Projects capped at twice their daily commitment, so a binge never beats a habit
field.p3: XP, ranks and a streak that forgives a missed day with a freeze
field.title: A field, not a to-do list

money.body: The granary logs what you spend, day by day. When it syncs, it is encrypted on your device with a passphrase the server never sees.
money.p1: Amounts in DZD, USD or EUR, with categories of your own
money.p2: End-to-end encrypted sync for money and places
money.p3: An account is optional: Harvest works fully without one
money.title: Money that stays yours

notes.body: Write down what a streak cannot hold, and plant the steps as seeds. Keep notes in folders, linked to each other.
notes.p1: Goals with what they take, their steps and the seeds that serve them
notes.p2: Markdown notes with [[links]] and what links back
notes.p3: Every note exports as a plain file, an Obsidian vault as it stands
notes.title: Goals and notes beside the field

home.lead: Your goals are seeds. Your effort is water. Distractions are weeds. Show up a little every day, keep your streak alive, and harvest the life you are growing.
home.offline: Works with no connection. Your data lives on your device.

pillar.financesBody: Log what you spend in seconds, keep the month in view.
pillar.focusBody: A focus timer, and screen time on the way.
pillar.healthBody: Sleep, weight, steps and the gym, on the phone.
pillar.productivityBody: Habits on a schedule, projects with a daily commitment, to-dos for a day.

home.title: Grow the life you are planting
home.whatBody: One field of seeds (habits, projects and to-dos) and one streak, fed by every part of your day. The field tells you what wants attention today; the streak says whether you showed up.

onboardingWeb.extrasBody: Each stays hidden unless you say yes. You can change your mind in Settings at any time.
onboardingWeb.extrasTitle: A few more, if you want them
onboardingWeb.remindersOnPhone: Reminders are switched on in the phone app, where they ring.
onboardingWeb.templatesBody: Pick a few to start with — you can always plant more.
onboardingWeb.welcomeBody:
Your goals are seeds. Your effort is water. Distractions are weeds.

Show up a little every day, keep your streak alive, and harvest the life you're growing.

passphrase.firstTime: Nothing sealed has arrived yet, so it cannot be checked: type it twice. Use the same one on every device.
passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.lead: Money is encrypted on your devices with a key made from this passphrase. It is not your password, and the server never sees it. Type it once in this browser.
passphrase.title: Sync passphrase
passphrase.warning: If you lose it, the encrypted rows cannot be read on a new device — only sent again from one that still has it.
passphrase.wrong: This passphrase does not open what your other devices sent. Enter the one you used there.

places.deleteAllBody: Every trail point, every geotag and every saved place will be deleted from this browser and, once it syncs, from your other devices. This cannot be undone.
places.emptyBody: Places is switched on per phone: the trail is recorded there, and the days appear here once they sync.
places.geotagHint: Asks this browser where it is when you log something, and keeps the place with it. Private and encrypted like the rest of Places. Off until you turn it on.
places.geotagRefused: This browser was not allowed to share its location.
places.geotagUnsupported: This browser cannot tell where it is.
places.historyHint: A day's trail can be deleted and brought back. Deleting all of it removes every point, geotag and saved place, on every device, for good.
places.nothingInSpan: Nothing was recorded in these days.
places.placeNameHint: e.g. Home, the bakery, the dam…
places.rightClickHint: Right-click (or long-press) the map anywhere to save a place.
places.title: Places

planner.empty: Nothing planned yet. Add tomorrow’s seeds tonight and wake up ready.
planner.nothing: Nothing planned yet — plant tonight’s seeds.
planner.title: Tomorrow’s plan

assist.body: It carries exactly what its sheet names, and nothing more.
assist.title: An assist action you tap

exercise.body: A plain download of a static file, with no account, device id or history attached.
exercise.title: An exercise animation you open

fonts.body: Fonts and icons are served with the app. There are no analytics, no ads and no trackers.
fonts.title: No third parties

rates.body: A request to api.frankfurter.dev for today’s EUR to USD rate. It carries nothing about you.
rates.title: Exchange rates, when you tap Fetch

site.body: Your browser downloads the app from this server. Once installed, it opens with no connection at all.
site.title: Loading this site

sync.body: Your rows go to the Harvest server so your devices agree. Money and places are encrypted on your device first, with a passphrase the server never sees.
sync.title: Sync, once you have signed in

tiles.body: The tile server learns the area on screen, never your trail.
tiles.title: Map tiles while you look at Places

privacy.lead: Nothing leaves your device unless you ask. This is the complete list.
privacy.nothingElse: Anything else would be a bug, not a feature.
privacy.signOutBody: Signing out of the web app deletes everything it stored in this browser, after warning you about anything not synced yet.
privacy.staysBody: Everything else: your field, notes, goals and money live on your device. In a browser they live in its local storage, and the app works from there even offline.
privacy.title: What leaves your device

pwa.updateReady: A new version of Harvest is ready.

ratesWeb.explainer: Used to show $ and € amounts in your default currency.
ratesWeb.fetchNote: Fetching asks api.frankfurter.dev for today's rate, and sends nothing about you.
ratesWeb.invalid: That is not a usable rate

search.lead: Type to search; arrows move, Enter opens.

seed.editorLead: A habit, a project, or a simple to-do.

settingsWeb.clashTitle_one: One reminder is now in your sleep
settingsWeb.clashTitle_other: {{count}} reminders are now in your sleep
settingsWeb.cycleBelowTarget: {{hours}} hours of sleep. Eight is the target.
settingsWeb.cycleGood: {{hours}} hours of sleep — that's the target.
settingsWeb.cycleHint: The app bends to your hours, not the other way round.
settingsWeb.cycleTooShort: {{hours}} hours is less than anyone should run on. Eight is the target, five the floor.
settingsWeb.extrasLead: Parts of the app that stay out of the way until you ask for them. Switching one off hides its tab; it never deletes anything.

feature.galleryHint: Albums of photos over time, playable as a run. A scheduled album becomes a seed on your field.
feature.gymHint: Programs, sessions and personal records. A gym habit lands on your field like any other seed.
feature.healthHint: Sleep, steps read from the phone's own health store, and a body weight whenever you stand on the scale.
feature.notesHint: Markdown notes in folders, linked to each other.
feature.placesHint: Where I went, and what I did there, read by the phone. Switching it on here asks nothing yet: location stays off until the phone is allowed to use it, and the trail is started on the phone.

settingsWeb.onPhoneLead: These are set in the Android app, because they need the phone itself.
settingsWeb.ownNightsHint: Saturday is not Tuesday. A weekday set here overrides the daily cycle for its night's sleep target.

phone.appLockHint: It uses the phone's own fingerprint, face or PIN.
phone.remindersHint: The morning review, the evening plan, the expense check-in and the streak nudge.
phone.sleepAlarmHint: They ring at the hours of the daily cycle set here.
phone.stepsHint: Counted by the phone's health store; the goal and stride are set on the Body tab.

site.footerLine: Harvest keeps your days on your devices. Nothing leaves them unless you ask.
site.iosHow: Add it to your home screen
site.notFoundBody: That page does not exist. The field is this way.

sleepWeb.deleteBody: It leaves the line, the debt is worked out again without it, and the XP it earned is taken back.
sleepWeb.lead: Two times and a feeling. Nothing here was measured, and none of it is a test.
sleepWeb.noNights: No nights written down yet. Log last night one morning and the line starts.
sleepWeb.notANight: Those two times do not make a night. Falling asleep goes from 8 PM the evening before, waking up to 3 PM.
sleepWeb.title: The night before {{day}}

stats.empty: Nothing to count yet. Check in once and the numbers start.
stats.heatLabel: Productive actions over the last {{count}} days
stats.title: The run so far

stepsWeb.goalHint: Optional. Meeting it is worth +5 XP, paid by the phone where the steps are counted. Leave it empty for no goal.
stepsWeb.noDays: No steps counted yet. The phone counts them; they arrive here when it syncs.
stepsWeb.strideHint: About 0.415 × your height. 75 cm is a fair guess; a tape measure is better.

streak.freezeExplainer: A freeze protects your streak for one missed day. It’s used automatically.
streak.freezeUnavailable: Not enough coins, or the shed is full.
streak.phoneJudges: The phone judges each closed day at 3 AM, spending freezes before a streak breaks. The web counts today’s check-ins as they happen.

vault.debtRemindHint: Reminders ring on the phone; empty keeps its default time.
vault.noDebtsBody: Nothing owed to anyone. Log a debt and it shows here with what is left.
vault.noMatchBody: Try a different category, form or word.

refused.overdraw: The pot does not hold that much.

vault.removePaymentBody: What it took from the wallet comes back, and the debt reopens if this had settled it.

voice.missing: The file is on another device for now.

voice.recordingHint: Stop and keep puts the recording in this note. It stays in this browser until it is sent with the next sync.

weightWeb.deleteBody: It leaves the chart. You can undo this straight away.

weightWeb.label: Weight ({{unit}})
weightWeb.lead: Whenever you stand on the scale. More than once a day is fine — morning and evening are different facts.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.buyEmptyBody: Add what you mean to pick up soon — the buy list is day to day.
wishlist.wishEmptyBody: Add what you want someday, with at most an estimate in mind.

wishlist.titleHint: e.g. Winter coat, kettle, espresso machine
wishlist.estimateInvalid: Type a price above zero, or leave it empty.
